name: H6b - Mobility vs Durability: ReconSquad vs MainBattleTank in Urban Grid
hypothesis: H6: In an urban grid with frequent line-of-sight breaks, the ReconSquad's detection and mobility advantages may allow it to avoid unfavorable engagements and potentially win through flanking.
description: Same ReconSquad vs MainBattleTank matchup but on a dense urban grid map with scattered obstacles that break line of sight. This tests whether terrain complexity shifts the mobility/durability balance.
expected_observations: ReconSquad should win a significantly higher percentage than on the open field (>30% vs <15%), demonstrating that complex terrain amplifies mobility and detection advantages.
